verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Awake, awake, oh north wind
Awake, awake, oh south wind
Blow over me
Come, oh winds of testing
Come, winds of refreshing
Blow over me

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
Let the winds blow, let the winds blow
Let the winds blow, let the winds blow

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Fling wide the door to my soul
Open up the door to my heart
Have Your way, have Your way
Have Your way

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
I won't be afraid
I will face the wind
I won't be afraid
I'll embrace the flame

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Take me through the fire, take me through the rain
Take me through the testing, I'll do anything
Test me, try me, prove me, refine me
Like the gold, like the gold
